title: Galois's theory of solvable equations
summary: While still a teenager, Galois found a necessary and sufficient condition for a polynomial equation to be solvable by radicals, founding Galois theory.
why: Founded group theory and modern algebra.

unsung.contribution: Founded Galois theory, explaining when polynomial equations can be solved by radicals.
unsung.recognition: A memoir sent to the Academy was lost; he died at 20 and Liouville acknowledged his work's value only in 1843.
